description: Get counts of the trades in CTA's records broken down by chamber (House vs Senate), with optional date filter. Senate counts since October 23, 2026 are partial (see the server instructions).

days.description: Look-back window in days, measured on trade date. Disclosures can arrive up to 45 days after the trade (later if filed late), so the newest part of any window is incomplete.

name: get_chamber_breakdown
title: Chamber Breakdown
